text: Gardening is a pleasant and fulfilling activity. It provides a serene and aesthetically pleasing environment for relaxation and recreation. A successful garden begins with well-prepared soil, which is why compost is fundamental. Compost comprises organic material that has been broken down into a nutrient-rich substance ideal for plant growth. This natural fertilizer promotes the development of robust and healthy plants, as well as enhances the soil's structure and fertility. Once your soil is prepared, a layer of organic mulch can be added to maintain soil moisture and keep weeds at bay. Mulch is a layer of organic material that overlays the soil around plants, suppressing weeds, retaining moisture, and adding organic matter to the soil. Mulching offers an easy way to enhance the beauty of your garden, as it contributes to a visually appealing landscape. Consequently, to start your garden, begin by ensuring you have the appropriate soil, then add compost and mulch to create a flourishing and attractive garden environment.
